data.title: CoreWeave Stock Rally Fizzles Despite ARK's Wood, Nvidia Support

data.title: Stock Market Swings On AI Fears, Tumbling Yields; Taiwan Semi, ASML, JPMorgan In Focus: Weekly Review
data.description: Amid concerns over artificial intelligence financing and decreasing Treasury yields, the stock market experienced a divide as major indexes either tested or surpassed key levels. This upheaval added volatility to the market, with attention specifically on Taiwan Semiconductor, ASML, and JPMorgan. This weekly review highlights the fluctuations in the market and the impact of AI fears and falling yields on investors.

data.title: Materialise NV to Report Third Quarter 2026 Earnings on Wednesday, October 28, 2026
data.description: Belgium-based Materialise NV (MTLS), known for 3D-printed medical devices and additive manufacturing solutions, will disclose its Q3 results for September 30, 2026, on October 28, 2026, at 2:00 a.m. ET/7:00 a.m. CET. The company, listed on Euronext & NASDAQ, will have senior executives conduct a conference call the same day to analyze the financial outcomes for Q3 2026.
